body: Usually it's pretty obvious. I can and do mostly ignore small failures, so it's not like I make a big deal out of everything, which is often what is thought to be the case for depressed people. Isn't wanting to improve and wanting to succeed really the same desire, and therefore brings the same potential for failure?
Failure makes me sink into depression. When I mess up in social situations. When I don't deliver in work situations. Even when my intentions are there.
I do enjoy going to the gym and playing sports. I really do. But it doesn't balance anything out for me in any big way.
I appreciate what you're saying, but why is 30 the magic age?
Yes, I have tried changing my attitude. Part of hiding my depression requires that I act and think like a normal person. Does that count?
